correctness.rationale: Stationary orientation densities (2Iv)^{-1}, with I=∫dx/v, J=∫λdx/v, give a corrector with constant difference L/J and bounded derivative −1+Lλ/(Jv); the corrected displacement martingale has asymptotic bracket L²/(IJ), hence D_eff=L²/(2IJ). Fixed means minimize weighted flip cost Σf_iλ_i/v_i by putting all λ in faster zone. Single-variable derivative of R_f has sign opposite fr²+(f−1)r−2f; its unique root >1 gives global optimum, at f=1/2, r=2 and 32/27. Independent exact symbolic derivative and Taylor checks and sample finite-state calculations corroborate; no simulation establishes the infinite result.
